biggest_catch: Your friend must complete a demanding checklist within 60 days (open checking, MK-Friend code, eStatements, mobile app used once, 20 debit-card purchases) and the $100 is not deposited until about one month AFTER the 60-day anniversary - roughly 90 days from account opening.
catches: Referrer must be an existing CCU Florida member; must be 16+ to refer (minor accounts need an adult holder).

Friend must open a NEW checking account ($25 initial deposit) plus a $5 one-time membership share fee; membership limited to Brevard, Indian River, Orange, Osceola, Polk, and Volusia County (FL) residents.
Friend must enter Marketing Code MK-Friend (online) or present the Refer-a-Friend form/card (branch).
Friend must sign up for eStatements, download and use the mobile app at least once, and make 20 debit-card purchases/payments (no minimum amount; ATM excluded) within 60 days of opening.
Account must be in good standing (no NSF activity) at payout.
$100 deposited to both accounts within one month of the new account's 60-day anniversary date - ~90 days after opening.
Excludes business and organizational accounts; cannot be combined with other promotional account-opening offers; offer subject to change.
